page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.2xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose server instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, paired with 32.0 GB of RAM, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or GPU accelerators. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that this instance sits primarily in the lower tiers for modern compute tasks. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance via stress-ng and Geekbench fall into the bottom 25% and bottom 10% respectively, reflecting the older architecture of the Broadwell-generation processor. However, memory bandwidth for large uncached blocks (both read and write) performs at an average level, as does the Passmark CPU extended instructions test. LLM inference speeds for small 135M models are average, but drop to poor for larger 7B models.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.sn2ne.2xlarge offers predictable compute resources, though at a lower performance-per-resource ratio compared to newer hardware generations. The absence of local storage means workloads must rely on network-attached storage, which is constrained by the 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. This instance is best suited for general-purpose workloads, basic web serving, development environments, and legacy applications that require dedicated CPU cores but do not demand high-performance compute or high-speed local I/O.
